question: In a certain code language, 'FOLDER' is coded as 'PCBJMD'. What is the code for 'DOLLAR' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'FOLDER' is coded as 'PCBJMD',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b048397613ecc09d4e0f91e900a65de8baedaa35f1804a6e2bf2fd7ba571150.png] 

Similarly, for 'DOLLAR'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0339a5f52d5e50643d836f687080fdad91da4784025fd0ec21ef692413cb4451.png] 

So, 'DOLLAR' is coded as 'PYJJMB'.
